scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Welcome to Cool Event Corp.
Our staff is always working
to surpass your expactations
for quality service. So how
may I assist you today?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
欢迎光临酷活动公司！
我们的职员始终致力于
超越您的期望，
提供优质的服务。
请问今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using the
Cool Event Corp. service~
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您的复活点
已保存在这里
{0}。
感谢您使用酷活动公司的服务~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您需要
初学者的基本技能
达到6级，
才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough Zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is 40 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法使用仓库服务。
使用仓库需要40 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Let me open your personal
storage for you right away.
Thanks for supporting Cool
Event Corp. by using our
services. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
让我马上为您打开
个人仓库。
感谢您使用酷活动公司的服务。
祝您有美好的一天~

请选择
您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法使用瞬间移动服务。
传送到{0}的费用是{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务
仅对商人职业开放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, White Smiths,
Alchemists and Creators.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务
仅对商人、铁匠、
白铁匠、炼金术士
和创造者开放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You can only rent a cart after
learning the Pushcart Skill.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您必须先学会
手推车使用技能，
才能租用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您已经装备了
手推车。
很遗憾，我们一次
不能向每位顾客
出租多辆手推车。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 Zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
手推车租赁费是800 Zeny。
您要租用手推车吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
Zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法支付800 Zeny的
手推车租赁费。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Cool Event Corp. is always
striving to provide the best
services for our customers.
Help us become the best by
providing us with your opinions
and honest feedback. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
酷活动公司始终致力于
为顾客提供最好的服务。
请通过提供您的意见
和诚实的反馈，
帮助我们成为最好的公司。
谢谢。
